articles.dek: Kim Keum-hwa (1931-2019) was a master shaman born in Jangyon, South Hwanghae Province, in what is now North Korea — a region once known for its rich shamanic traditions. articles.title: Democrats want amnesia on inflation
articles.dek: There’s a reason Democrats are focused on affordability: It is a daily reality, and many Democratic policies make it worse.
